evidence.title: GitHub - poweroutlet2/browser-extension-starter: Browser extension starter template featuring WXT, React, Shadcn, and TRPC · GitHub

name: Browser Extension Starter Template
summary: Chrome extension boilerplate with WXT, React, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui and tRPC messaging, plus a Plasmo branch.
description: A boilerplate for building Chrome extensions, initialized with WXT, React, TailwindCSS, shadcn/ui and trpc-chrome for typesafe messaging between extension parts. It is published as a GitHub template; a plasmo branch starts the same setup on Plasmo instead. New shadcn components are added with the shadcn CLI, and development builds load from ./output/chrome-mv3-dev.
contains: boilerplate for Chrome extensions with WXT, React, TailwindCSS, shadcn/ui and trpc-chrome
typesafe messaging between extension parts via trpc-chrome
plasmo branch for starting with Plasmo instead of WXT
new UI components added with the shadcn CLI
